purpose: Single current record for discovery decisions, known defects and required acceptance. Dated research is supporting evidence, not a competing task list.
closure_rule: W0 resolves discovery and assigns named owners; W2-W5 implement and pass their contracts. Before cutover, W6 requires all W6-gated checks and decisions with candidate/configuration-bound evidence. Explicit W7 production outcomes remain NOT_RUN until after the authorized switch; they are not fabricated or required before deployment. No policy approval or inherited test result alone makes a check pass. Final completion includes W7 acceptance. No progress percentage is inferred from this incomplete inventory.
evidence_rule: Historical/source/metadata observations retain their original scope. Verification requires a named reviewer, recorded result, candidate/configuration/environment and evidence reference. Reuse manual evidence only with a recorded unchanged relevant scope. Do not store secrets or participant data here.

items.title: Kit-evidence access, retention and compensation

decision.required: Allowed readers, retention origin/window/exceptions, orphan grace period and treatment of expired evidence after restore.

invariants: Keep existing Storage; evidence reads are authorized and event-scoped in the replacement. Unknown legacy actor/time stays unknown.
After a lost update response, recover the original registration/object reference before compensation; never delete a possibly committed attachment blindly.

acceptance.pass_when: Assigned user reads synthetic evidence; anonymous, unrelated-event and revoked users fail, including copied old public links after cutover. Old-app compatibility is maintained until the coordinated switch.

Supported Storage deletion removes expired objects, preserves unexpired/held objects and safely reruns; forced cleanup/removal failure reaches the responder and retries. Restore obeys the approved access/expiry policy.

Upload failure, upload success followed by a definite update error, zero-row update, committed-but-lost response and failed removal produce no false handover. Referenced evidence survives; proven unreferenced files are eventually removed with visible failures.

items.title: Traceable historical defect closure

decision.required: Confirm retained workflows and explicit disposition of every prior defect; local fixes require regression and applicable hosted/device evidence.

invariants: A historical report is not proof a bug remains; a local fix is not proof the deployed path passes.

acceptance.pass_when: Original and reprinted $700/two-folio receipt agree; relay member changes recalculate correctly; wrong-event/group folios resolve safely; civil-date boundaries, handover ordering and required quotation/WhatsApp formats match approved behavior.

items.title: Registration snapshots and applicable consent

decision.required: Per-event fields/consent and acceptance step, correction cutoff, old missing-evidence treatment; minors/guardians only if applicable. No size-stock or courtesy-entry feature is assumed.

invariants: Freeze accepted participant/package/shirt choices and applicable consent evidence on the entry; profile preferences cannot silently rewrite prior entitlements.
Corrections retain before/after, actor, time and reason; buyer, participant, account ownership and consent remain distinct.

acceptance.pass_when: Online/cash/direct API enforce approved fields at the chosen step; later profile edits leave prior receipts/kit choices intact; reused request IDs cannot swap accepted snapshots. Missing old consent remains unknown.

Authorized typo/contact/DOB correction is audited and preserves payment/folio identity; unauthorized ownership changes fail. Companion and any applicable guardian evidence follow the approved separate states.

items.title: Refund, eligibility and attended-history outcomes

decision.required: Whole-order review versus participant-scoped resolution, kit/capacity effects, fee/funding policy after payout, public-recognition treatment and support deadlines for paid/no-place or distinct duplicate purchases.

invariants: Retain the whole-order safety hold until an approved replacement rule is implemented; provider-originated adjustments remain processable even if an optional refund UI action is unavailable.

Financial changes alone do not erase observed attendance or its event/registration identity. Authorized personal history distinguishes retained observation from current entry eligibility, subject to approved lawful retention and rights handling; public sharing/recognition follows its separate approved rule.

acceptance.pass_when: Three-person captured order with one confirmed attendee receives partial refund and replay/dispute transitions: exact money/fee totals and selected eligibility rule hold; no accidental capacity release; attendance evidence and authorized personal history remain truthful. Exercise the SQL/RPC path, not just a UI helper.

Late captured/no-place and fresh duplicate-purchase cases reach the named owner and approved resolution without extra folios/refunds. Funding failure or unresolved dispute has visible state, payer communication and escalation.

items.title: Race editions, disruption and attendance correction

decision.required: Postpone/cancel remedies and contacts; allowed corrections versus transfers; capacity unit and civil cutoffs; observation that confirms attendance and authorized correction procedure.

invariants: The existing event ID identifies an edition; next year uses a distinct event record. A postponement records the date change without turning old entries into a new edition.
A profile edit cannot transfer ownership or imply attendance; payment, reprint and kit pickup alone do not confirm attendance.

acceptance.pass_when: Postpone/cancel a sold edition with a pending payment using the approved remedy: IDs/entitlements and notice ownership remain coherent, replay cannot double-refund, cancellation creates no attendance. A new annual edition leaves prior history unchanged.
Allowed correction/transfer follows an authorized audited transition or is explicitly refused; attendance observation/correction retains actor/time/reason and respects verified participant ownership.

items.title: Physical handover, connectivity and queue operation

decision.required: Proxy and partial-group pickup evidence/correction; peak arrival window, available stations/connectivity and numeric service goal. Confirm online-required pause/recovery or separately qualify a required controlled fallback.

invariants: Baseline requires an authoritative online response for new sale/kit/attendance mutations; show unknown outcome and recover the original record. No multi-device offline queue or parallel manual ledger is assumed.

One authorized transition per registration precedes handover; a group receipt/reprint does not grant another kit. If interrupted between recording and physical handover, a lead resolves the uncertainty with an audit trail; stored status alone cannot prove physical delivery. Each operator keeps only assigned permissions.

acceptance.pass_when: Two stations attempt the same participant; approved proxy and partial group collection, wrong-event code and post-collection reprint preserve one entitlement, visible conflicts and an audited correction path. Test disconnect before submission, response loss after commit, and interruption between recorded claim and physical handover; the lead resolves uncertainty without automatic repeat delivery.

Timed ACTV arrival burst with novice operator and shift change meets the recorded target; no-phone/same-name cases, recent purchase, recovery exception and paper-out have a usable lead route. Include shared-printer contention where applicable; more tablets alone cannot be assumed to increase paper/handover capacity. Use existing equipment or record a shortfall before assuming purchases.

items.title: Burst, migration and abuse qualification

decision.required: Declare arrival profile, latency/backlog goals, lock/statement/deployment budgets and abuse limits; ACTV operations accepts sales-pause and retry/exception behavior.

invariants: Reuse current idempotency, holds, allocator and bounded recovery. Keep account creation optional and guest checkout available; protect legitimate shared-Wi-Fi/family traffic.
Throttling/new-creation pause does not discard signed callbacks or accepted-order fulfillment. Migration timeout/abort must preserve and reconcile accepted work.

acceptance.pass_when: Run 1,500 purchases using a declared overlapping-event burst; use the historical 300 orders/minute model as an initial hypothesis. Include representative accumulated records and highest-supported configuration shapes; measure a hot event while other events and staff lookup stay usable. Record actual arrivals, failures, per-event latency, lock/pool pressure and backlog drain; zero unpaid/duplicate folios or oversell. Real provider sandbox checks remain separate.

With representative old data, a held competing transaction, accepted pending orders and delayed callbacks, supported migrations either complete within declared budgets or fail observably through the rehearsed recovery path. Inspect partial application; then reconcile all accepted work before reopening.

Direct RPC/Edge and rotated-request attempts cannot bypass hold/claim/request limits; legitimate declared shared-IP guests/families still complete. Same-request retries add no holds; abandoned holds release correctly; accepted lookup, callbacks and recovery remain usable.

items.title: Concrete public origins and retained destinations

decision.required: Choose public origin and retained/redirected/authorized-retired destination for every inventoried route; identify DNS/routing owners.

invariants: Preserve existing store/account/reset and retained content by correct links/routing; excluded imports do not become a continuity dependency.

acceptance.pass_when: Inventory paths, media, deep links, Auth and payment returns reach intended destinations without loops/conflicts. Safely smoke-test retained store/account/reset paths; replacement race/order lookup and bundled receipt assets work during a staged WordPress outage. No live purchase or customer-data copying is implied.

items.title: Complete release baseline, access and continuity

acceptance.pass_when: Curated app/schema/functions/config/jobs identify one candidate; clean and representative in-place full-schema upgrades pass. Role/claim/provision/revoke matrix denies cross-event/user access and preserves existing valid IDs/folios/capacity. Ordinary verify rejects production and cannot deploy, alter hosted secrets, charge or print.

items.title: All-channel finance, guest recovery and delivery

acceptance.pass_when: Individual/group/relay online, cash and qualified actual reader use one ledger. MX/US/CA-in-MXN and 3DS success/abandonment/decline, refunds/disputes and missed notices pass; guest and counter restart recover originals. Actual test email/folio delivery, organizer settlement ownership and cash close/deposit matching are demonstrated.

items.title: Real equipment and retained staff capabilities

acceptance.pass_when: Actual Samsung/PT210 route and identified reader pass paper/QR/accents/group/reconnect/restart/camera tests. Print request is not claimed physical success; retries reuse original folios. Capability matrix covers clubs/users/assignments/reports/clients/services/quotations/WhatsApp, and assigned tasks need no SQL/CLI/developer.

items.title: Recovery, alert delivery and maintenance handover

acceptance.pass_when: Named primary/backup and numeric coverage/response/health thresholds exist. Independent heartbeat plus capture/review/refund/recovery/cleanup failures reach and escalate to them, including failed background operations while pages still return HTTP 200. Database AND kit evidence restore within accepted recovery limits, with cash/provider reconstruction using original identities.

One runbook records monthly support/update review, urgent triage/mitigation targets, quarterly/relevant-change restores and station-update regression. If the shared dashboard is integrated, prove it receives only authenticated aggregate health/version/age signals; otherwise record NOT_INTEGRATED and prove the working fallback and independent heartbeat without it. A working alert route is mandatory; its provisional pilot wording cannot override ACTV's whole-release/cutover controls.

items.title: Closed-gate total cutover and first shift

acceptance.pass_when: All inventoried old issuers/stale clients and new guest/cash/card creation are closed at the backend. Pending accepted payments still settle exactly once; lookup/reprints remain. Matching whole-release evidence and old-writer shutoff precede one authorized reopen. Any new order/attempt invokes preserve-and-reconcile recovery, never blind snapshot restore.

Refresh real obligation/registration counts, execute the rehearsed switch, reconcile authorized controlled live checks and first shift, and confirm the old race/POS and obsolete issuers are off while the existing store remains intact. Creating this record does not authorize deployment or a live charge.

items.title: Mexican privacy, rights and conditional minors obligations
legal_references: Compatible current privacy regulation: processor/cloud/security/incident provisions
October 14, 2026 digital-environments decree articles 1-5 and transitories: applicability must be determined, not assumed

decision.required: Identify actual controller(s), purposes and data classes, consent or documented exception, privacy contact, retained-store boundary, vendor/organizer roles and cross-border treatment. Decide minor admission/representation and the 2026 decree's scope against actual features, including public sharing. No new social, biometric or age-service feature is presumed.

invariants: Preserve private personal race history; optional public sharing starts private and is separately revocable. A sport waiver is not automatically privacy consent, guardian authority or consent to publish kit evidence.

Collect no unnecessary identity/biometric/billing data. Financial-record holds and statutory exceptions constrain deletion; neither privacy cancellation nor the attendance invariant means retain everything forever or delete every audit record.
Observed public storage/failed retention is a control gap, not proof of a notifiable breach. Mandatory legal protections cannot be waived by a product-policy approval.

acceptance.pass_when: Approved controller/purpose/vendor map matches real online, guest/group, account, staff-assisted and photo collection points and reachable Spanish notices. Evidence proves the applicable consent/exception and optional-purpose rules. Sharing defaults private, excludes unrelated/financial/evidence data and revokes correctly. Minor/guardian and decree applicability is explicitly decided; applicable controls and transition obligations are evidenced, or a reasoned non-applicability determination is recorded.

A synthetic guest/runner or approved representative request reaches the named privacy contact, passes proportionate identity checks, records the applicable 20-business-day determination deadline and 15-business-day implementation deadline from communication of a favorable determination, including justified legal extensions, and completes with no third-person/group disclosure. Show correction, appropriate deletion/blocking, a justified financial-record retention exception, revocation and expired-data handling after restore. Reuse G1 tests.

Reuse G1/W2 access cases to deny anonymous/unrelated/revoked reads and old public-link bypass. An incident exercise reaches the responder/privacy owner, records containment and impact, and applies the legally grounded notification decision and timing. Suspected exposure/control failures trigger assessment without waiting for proof an outsider downloaded a file; configuration alone does not establish every breach fact. No unrelated GDPR 72-hour clock is substituted for Mexican requirements.

items.title: Mexican consumer, payment and receipt responsibilities
legal_references: LFPC current consolidated law: articles 7, 7 BIS, 12, 32, 76 BIS/76 BIS1 and applicable mandatory remedies
CFF articles 29, 29-A, 30; Commerce articles 38/49 and applicable conservation treatment: confirm with actual issuer/accountant
LRITF article 22 perimeter is conditional; PCI/provider requirements are separate contractual scope

decision.required: Approve actual seller/contact, inclusive price and who bears ACTV/provider fees, cancellation/refund remedies, funds/account ownership, disputes, invoice issuers and existing CFDI route. Confirm whether paid recurrence exists. Legal reviewer determines actual financial perimeter; provider/device validation determines PCI scope.

invariants: Do not infer an extra consumer charge from ACTV's $15 commission. Advertised final MXN amount, order, payment and receipt match the approved pricing contract.
A printed ticket or Stripe receipt is not automatically a CFDI. Use the existing approved accountant/provider route if adequate; do not collect every runner's RFC or build a tax engine by default.

Do not infer fintech licensing or universal PCI compliance from using Stripe. Keep raw PAN/CVC outside ACTV pages, storage, logs and printed receipts; shared tablet, retained store and actual reader/provider paths require their own applicable validation.
Consumer policies cannot waive mandatory remedies. One-off entries/free accounts do not automatically require recurring-subscription engineering; any actual recurrence is explicitly assessed.

acceptance.pass_when: Public registration/POS shows approved seller/contact, security/terms and cancellation/help route with inclusive MXN totals; group quantities/mandatory fees match server order, checkout and receipt. Record whether paid recurrence exists; if applicable prove the required consent/notice/cancellation path, otherwise record the reasoned boundary.

Reuse G4 to resolve an approved cancellation/postponement or duplicate-payment case with correct statutory remedy, refund/fee ledger and customer communication. Preserve observed attendance subject to its approved correction/retention rule; unresolved funding/disputes remain visibly owned.

Evidence actual entities, organizer processor-account ownership and funds/refund/dispute flow, tablet/reader provider path and applicable PCI validation; legal reviewer closes conditional financial-regulatory scope. Show an accurately labelled sale receipt, synthetic invoice-request path and approved existing CFDI issuer/provider capability without inventing a real fiscal sale. Record statutory retention/integrity responsibilities with the accountant; no new wallet/custody/tax platform is assumed.

source_consolidation.scope: Source candidate with complete captured operational baseline on isolated actual Supabase services and atomic staff lifecycle; hosted/device/cutover acceptance remains unqualified.
